scope: Read-only comparison of upper and lower front SWD rows against the unmodified baseline; no board or schematic changes made by this review.

measurement_method.foreign_copper: Euclidean shortest distance from proposed pad center to an existing F.Cu line segment or through-via center, minus the 0.4 mm proposed pad radius and existing copper half-width/radius. Existing same-net copper is excluded. Negative distance means copper overlap.
measurement_method.drill: Euclidean distance to each via center minus 0.4 mm pad radius and half drill diameter. Same-net drills are included; negative distance means the drill overlaps the contact pad.
measurement_method.courtyard: Distance from proposed circular pad copper edge to U1 rectangular courtyard centerline. A second metric subtracts 0.025 mm (half of the actual 0.05 mm F.CrtYd stroke), giving clearance to its visible outer stroke. Thus the symmetric rows have 2.000 mm centerline clearance and 1.975 mm visible-stroke clearance; these are the same geometry, not contradictory measurements.
measurement_method.edge: 6.75 mm board radius minus pad-center distance from (20,17), minus 0.4 mm pad radius.
measurement_method.excluded_refillable_zone: The baseline F.Cu GND pour is not treated as an immutable obstacle. Any implemented pads/traces require zone refill and full DRC; this comparison alone is not a DRC result.
measurement_method.pogo_access: Both symmetric rows have the same board-edge and U1 courtyard space. Pads need no paste and have 0.47 mm inter-pad copper gap. Only U1 is mounted on the baseline front. Fixture/probe body diameter, tolerance, enclosure clearance, stroke and opposite-side support geometry are not specified, so mechanical mating is not certified.

conclusion.selected: Keep the original lower row at absolute y=21.85 (relative y=+4.85).
conclusion.reason: The lower row has no baseline foreign-copper violations (minimum 0.249251 mm). The upper proposed row has three: J9/GND clearance 0.059119 mm, J10/3V3 overlap 0.162493 mm, J11/TXN_DRV overlap 0.389256 mm. J10 and J11 also overlap existing drill geometry.
conclusion.upper_adjustment: A simple vertical move within relative y=-5.1 to -4.6 cannot eliminate the J11/TXN_DRV via conflict. Moving to y=12.4 clears the J9/GND problem but worsens the J10 and J11 overlaps; an upper layout therefore requires at least those two via locations and their connected routing to be redesigned, followed by refill and DRC.
